texts.text:
You are the owner and founder of the
paranormal investigation service, GhostRid.
People hire you to determine the cause and
source of their haunting and get rid of it.
This typically involves learning as much as
you can about the location and the person or
people who died there. This is the most recent
job for which you’ve been hired.

Ever since workers began renovations on the 13th
floor of the Augustine Hotel, numerous reports have
come in about sightings of strange shadow people.
Are these sightings merely tricks of the light or
has all the recent construction awakened something
otherworldly? Grab your EMF meter, head on up to
the 13th floor, and investigate to find out the
true answer to this paranormal mystery.

As is the case with every investigation you
perform, you should do the following:

1.Read the reports about any deaths that occurred
  on the 13ᵗʰ floor throughout the location’s
  history.
2.Examine the interviews with the workers who
  have seen the shadow people.
3.Use the various tools in your paranormal
  investigation kit to rule out certain spirits.
4.Cleanse the location of the spirits that need
  help moving on and collect your fee from the
  Augustine Hotel.
DEATHS ON THE 13ᵀᴴ FLOOR

*These deaths have been independently confirmed
via public records and via psychic.

John and Mary Collins: Devoted husband and wife who
committed suicide together in room 1310 back in 2002
after finding out that Mary had terminal brain
cancer and was only expected to live a few more
weeks. They had been together since high school and
were unwilling to go on without each other. They
each took half a bottle of sleeping pills, downed a
fifth of whiskey, and died in an eternal embrace.

Fargo Pepper: A local musician known best as the
frontman for the band, Zombified Zeus, who was prone
to massive weekend partying in room 1319. On the
weekend he died in 2018, sources say Fargo did a
plethora of drugs including angel dust, meth,
mushrooms, and cocaine. The coroner ruled the death
as accidental since it was well known that Fargo
Pepper was a hard partyer and a lover of life.

Brotherhood of the Stars: A doomsday cult who formed
a pact to end it all in anticipation of the arrival
of the Mother Ship which would take them all to the
9ᵗʰ Heaven on December 25, 2018. There were five
members in all. Yet, strangely, none of them died as
the result of suicide. Instead, the group’s leader,
Baron Vance, murdered the other four members of the
cult in a blind rage after he discovered that
Goddess Athena, a female member of the group with
whom he was in love, had actually fallen for Brother
Anott who was also a member of the group. Grief
stricken and inconsolable, Baron shot everyone in
room 1302 and then shot himself. Or at least that is
what police think. Goddess Athena’s body was never
found. Investigators assume that Athena was dead.
However, there hasn’t been any concrete proof to
substantiate that claim.

Members of the group included:
 1.Baron Vance
 2.Goddess Athena
 3.Brother Anott
 4.Brother Paul
 5.Brother Black
SIGHTINGS ON THE 13ᵀᴴ FLOOR

Trey Garza: ‘Look, I don’t believe in this
stuff at all. But, I know what I saw. There
were two of them. They were people that looked
like shadows. They were darting back and forth
across the hall, going from room to room. It
was impossible to tell whether they were male
or female. But, they had definite human
characteristics. And yes, I’m sure it wasn’t
somebody playing a prank. We’ve been doing work
on the 13ᵗʰ floor for about three weeks now,
and I haven’t seen anything like this until we
started tearing into the sheetrock. Do you
think we are disturbing them? I did find
something weird written on the sheetrock we
tore out. See what you think.’

Alfonzo Smith: ‘This place is haunted. No
doubt. My grandmother used to tell me stories
about what happens when a spirit can’t rest.
It roams and seeks peace without ever finding
it. She was a psychic, and I believe she passed
some of her psychic gifts along to me as well.
When we first started seeing the shadow people,
I did some automatic writing which is where you
let the spirit guide your hand and use you to
pen their own message. The results I got were
interesting to say the least.’

Franklin Archer: ‘I don’t know how to answer
this specifically. I haven’t seen the shadow
people personally, but I know people who have.
And I trust those people. What I do know is
that I was hired as a painter, and I paint. I
spent an entire day painting only to come back
to the next day and find some sort of graffiti
painted over what I had done. Not happy! If it
is shadow people, they need to mind their own
business and leave the living alone.’
COMMAND CENTER

In some paranormal investigations, cameras are set up in various places
to monitor activity in the location. This place is usually referred to as
a command center/nerve center.

WHAT ARE THE FIRST NAMES
OF THE SHADOW PEOPLE IN
ALPHABETICAL ORDER?

WHAT DID THE SHADOW
PEOPLE DO?

SEARCH THE
PARKING GARAGE
(no caps, no spaces)

One of the things that got you
interested in the paranormal in
the first place was a gift of
clairvoyance that you’ve always
seemed to have. In the middle
of your investigation, you get
a vision that there is
something you are supposed to
read. But what is it and what
room number on the 13ᵗʰ floor
should you search (spell out)?
(no caps, no spaces)
Alfonzo Smith’s automatic writing:

scratches on wall
third is first
first is second
second is third
a joke on my name

Found written/scratched on torn
out sheetrock:

xF BSFOu
NBSSJFE
cVu BSF IF
BOETIF

Upon spending a night on the 13ᵗʰ floor, you spot the elusive
shadow figures on more than one occasion. You are fairly
certain there are at least two of them. You decide to do a
call and response EVP session in hopes one or both of them
will communicate. This is the transcript of the result:

You: Hi, if you’re one of the shadow people. I want to
talk. If you can speak my audio recorder may catch it.
I mean you no harm.

*hissing sounds*

You: Can you make a sign? Can you make a noise of some
sort?

*loud bang*

You: Thank you for that. I want to know more about you.
How did you die?

*hissing sounds*

You: Ok, can you tell me your name instead? Or tell me
something about you?

...mistake...

You: You made a mistake? Is that what you are trying to
tell me.

...there brad cloth believer fixed hobo cook sin wifi
alive...

You: Can you explain what you mean by that?

*hissing sounds*

You: Please keep talking.

*hissing sounds*

You: Help me out here?

...yz is your guide...

a. crucifix
b. holy water
c. digital voice recorder
d. EMF meter

q. candles
r. incense
s. bell
t. sigils
u. heat camera
v. digital camera
w. Polaroid camera
x. night vision
y. spirit box
z. Trifield meter

WHAT DO YOU
USE TO CLEANSE
THE 13ᵀᴴ FLOOR?

(in order,
no caps, no spaces)

You are reasonably certain that the two shadow people
lurking the corridors of the 13ᵗʰ floor are Fargo Pepper and
Goddess Athena (or Katie Brown as she was more
commonly known by those outside the cult). Hoping to get
results now that you know their names, you decide to do
another EVP session with a digital voice recorder.

You: Fargo and Katie, are you with me? If so, you can speak
and my recorder will possibly pick up your voices.
*here*

You: Ok great, I just want to understand what happened to
you.
*tragedy*
You: There was a tragedy. Were the two of you in love?
*secret*
You: Your love was a secret?
*trapped*
You: Trapped by the cult?
*Baron*

You: She was trapped by Baron Vance. What did you do
about it?
*off the record*

You: Ok, off the record, sure. But, if you're both dead then
you don't have anything to worry about. You can talk to
me.
*er...ay...and...you...king...kin...greed”

You: I am not sure what that means. Can you tell me
where to look?

After searching room 1305, you eventually find a
red book located in the air vent. It's a spell
book of some sort. The following note was left
inside:

"We've secretly been renting this room for a
while so no one would find out about us. The
13ᵗʰ floor isn't ideal since there is a chance
someone will see us. But the 13ᵗʰ floor is
essential to what we're about to do. The
number is significant. It holds power. We've
tried to keep things hidden. But we're tired of
hiding and are about to do something drastic.
She means everything to me. In case this goes
badly, look for this car in the parking garage.
The license plate is made up of the following
letters:

-Look to the Heavenly number.
-What does a pirate say?
-A pool stick is called this.
-My Goodness, Wow, Lord.
-Mine, Killer, Honey.
-Sweet, Pot, V."
INCANTATIONS

You find the license plate and the car attached to it without
too much trouble. The car is a black 1970 Chevrolet Chevelle.
From the look of things, the car has been sitting for a while to
judge by the thick layer of dust that covers it. A valet notices
you looking at the car and approaches.

'This car has been here for years," the valet explains. "I don't
think it even runs now. The old owner of the hotel didn't care
that it was here. He didn't care about most things which is
why he lost the hotel and someone else was able to buy it for a
steal. The new owner, however, is set on fixing this place up.
So, I would expect that this car will be towed to the junkyard
or sold at some point in the very near future. If you want to
check the car out, be my guest. It's nothing to me. The key is
under the visor."

There isn't much of note inside the car. But, when you look in
the trunk, you discover an old turntable and a single vinyl
record.

1. Summer One Day
2. So, Me and You...

3. Thinking
4. King Greed

You get a bad feeling the moment you set foot in room
1313. There is a heaviness in the air and you sense an evil
presence. The spirits of Fargo and Katie told you that they
summoned something in 1313. After spending several
minutes in the room, you notice a piece of sheetrock has
been replaced on one section of the wall. You use a
pocketknife to dig at the seam enough to allow you to get
your fingers behind it and pull the sheetrock away from the
stud. You see the mummified remains of a woman behind
the wall. She is holding a note. It reads:

"We were madly in love. But, the cult wasn't going to let he
r go. Baron wasn't going to let her go. In all my years of pl
aying with Zombified Zeus, I had heard stories about peopl
e dabbling in the occult and dealing in the black arts. I sug
gested that she and I do something like that to try and tur
n the tables on the cult. We were going to call something f
orth to do our bidding. I even got my hands on an incantat
ion book. It seems like an idiotic idea now. At the time, i
t was genius. Something like that couldn't land either of u
s in jail. The courts don't recognize the supernatura
1. So, if our plan worked, she could be free of the cult. I
f not, we were free to try something else. As it turned out,
our plan worked too well. We summoned something.
That something-an evil spirit, a demon, whatever yo
u want to call it-possessed Baron Vance and drove him t
o kill the other members of the group and himself. He
would have killed Katie too if I hadn't saved her. But,
once Baron was dead, whatever was inside him, found Katie
and took control of her, forcing her to attack me. She tri
ed to kill me, and ultimately, I stabbed her while defending m
yself. I know it wasn't her though. But, it broke my he
art. Every bit of this was my fault. I put her in this wall,
hoping that what we had unleashed would never see the lig
ht of day again. But, eventually, the evil came for me, and
it's inside me now. I'm barely in control of myself. I can
feel it getting stronger. I'm writing this letter before I head
back to my room where a bowl of pills awaits me.
Hopefully, this ends the tragedy, and I can be with my
Katie again. I want to spend my eternity with her. One
more thing though. I used a ouija board to ask whoever or
whatever was out there listening how to get rid of this
unclean spirit, and they told me to do the following: light
some candles, burn some sage, recite a very specific passage
from a certain prayer book, draw some sigils on the wall,
cut my palm with a knife and let the blood drip down, and
then ring a bell. If the presence is still roaming the
thirteenth floor, I would try this as a means of getting rid
of it. I would do it myself, but I can't since it lives inside of
me now. It won't allow it. I'm not even sure if it will allow
me to take my own life. We will see."

The evil presence in 1313 that Fargo and Katie
summoned knows that you are about to cleanse the
hotel and is none too happy about it. Items are hurled
across the room. Unseen hands push you and scratch
you. Your name is whispered with malevolent intent.
But, you stay focused. Using all of the items and steps
mentioned in Fargo's notes, you follow the instructions
perfectly, and when you are done, the room and the
entire building feels immediately lighter. It feels free.

As if on cue, two shadow people emerge from room
1305. At first the two figures are distinct and separate.
Then, inexplicably, the two meld into one shadow
figure. The sight confuses you at first until you
remember that Fargo and Katie were in love. And just
as two people symbolically become one when they get
married, Fargo and Katie have literally done their
version of that in front of your very eyes.

"Thank you," they whisper before exploding in a puff
of smoke and disappearing before your very eyes. The
sight might be touching if it wasn't so strange.

As far as you are concerned, their troubled souls have
moved on to the next life and the demonic presence
they summoned has been vanquished. The 13ᵗʰ floor is
now cleansed.

You head to the manager's office to give him the good
news and wonder if you should bill the hotel extra for
doing battle with the forces of evil. It certainly seems
like it would be worth an extra 10%. Onto the next
haunting.
Case closed.
